title: Use Seedance 2.5 (instead of 2.0) when generating from storyboard/shot…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 (instead of 2.0) when generating from storyboard/shot reference images to get higher adherence to the storyboard.  
If your reference/storyboard image has flaws you don’t want reproduced, fix/clean the reference first—Seedance 2.5 may copy the flaw directly.  
If your reference/storyboard image is square-ish but you need a vertical output, set the output aspect ratio to 9:16.

参照／ストーリーボード画像がほぼ正方形で、縦長の出力が必要な場合は、出力のアスペクト比を 9:16 に設定してください。
